blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Two more individuals died from dengue in Agusan del Sur, bringing the death toll to 18 as of Tuesday, data from the Provincial Health Office (PHO) showed. Since January 1, authorities recorded 2,775 dengue cases, with an overall fatality rate of 0.65 percent. The provincial government declared a province-wide dengue outbreak on Oct. 1, following a sustained surge in cases across several municipalities.
